name: Riverfront Sunset Social
description: Kick off the fall season with live local music, food vendors, lawn games, and an evening gathering along the riverfront.

name: Uptown Art After Dark
description: An evening art walk featuring pop-up galleries, street performers, local makers, and extended downtown shopping hours.

name: Chattahoochee Paddle & Picnic
description: A casual Saturday river outing with guided paddling, riverside picnic areas, outdoor demonstrations, and family activities.

name: Columbus Fall Food Fest
description: A tasting-focused fall festival bringing together regional restaurants, food trucks, dessert vendors, and live entertainment.

name: Garden Glow Night
description: An illuminated garden evening with lantern paths, acoustic music, seasonal refreshments, and family photo stops.

name: River City Harvest Market
description: A seasonal open-air market with produce, handmade goods, fall treats, demonstrations, and live music throughout the day.

name: Historic Columbus Lantern Walk
description: A guided twilight walk blending local history, architecture, storytelling, and softly lit outdoor stops.

name: Veterans Weekend Celebration
description: A community weekend honoring veterans with outdoor displays, family programs, music, and recognition ceremonies.

name: Uptown Holiday Preview
description: Downtown shops and restaurants launch the holiday season with evening specials, window displays, music, and street-side activities.

name: Thanksgiving Weekend RiverWalk
description: A relaxed post-Thanksgiving afternoon with riverfront vendors, warm drinks, music, and family-friendly activities.

name: River City Holiday Lights
description: A holiday lights celebration with seasonal music, food vendors, photo areas, and a festive evening atmosphere downtown.

name: Columbus Holiday Makers Market
description: A holiday shopping market showcasing regional makers, artists, baked goods, handcrafted gifts, and seasonal entertainment.

name: Winter on the River
description: A winter riverfront gathering with hot drinks, live music, fire pits, local vendors, and an evening stroll along the Chattahoochee.

name: River City New Year's Eve
description: Close out the year downtown with music, food, riverfront gathering areas, a countdown celebration, and a midnight finale.
